MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The long USB cable fits my pattern of buying practical desk accessories, provided its connectors match my devices.",
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful extension of my earlier home security purchases and could work with my recently purchased Echo Show.",
    "The JBL speaker connects with my interest in portable audio, although I would keep using my Amazon Tap until I need a replacement."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "An older Echo Dot and another Fire TV Stick repeat needs covered by my recent fourth-generation Dot, Echo Show, and Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle.",
    "The Apple TV remote case and AirPods Pro tips depend on devices I have not indicated owning; buying some Mac accessories does not establish that I own those products.",
    "The internal SSD and RGB fans imply computer upgrade projects, while my history shows external storage and everyday peripherals. The earbuds also lack a clear current use for me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa and Fire TV purchases seem to have been treated as reasons to buy more of the same devices, even when I recently bought newer versions.",
    "My computer accessory purchases seem to have been stretched into interest in internal components, and my Mac-compatible purchases into ownership of other Apple devices."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs are already covered; an accessory that adds a useful function is more appealing than another device doing the same job.",
    "Specific compatibility matters: the cable needs the right ports, and device-specific accessories need evidence that I own the matching device.",
    "My history includes replacements and accessories that keep existing equipment useful, such as Harmony batteries and the Echo Show stand. Related products are more compelling when they serve that kind of concrete need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in practical electronics and Alexa devices, but miss the difference between extending my setup and duplicating equipment I already have."
}
